mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong economic demand (GDPC1 > 20000) and weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates supply-demand imbalance that boosts equity valuations, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in less than 40% of instances where GDPC1 > 20000 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 265), central banks tighten policy expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 265, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS increasing) indicates stronger consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals real estate weakness that reduces consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances with HOUST < 1500, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 540000 million dollars and federal funds rate is below 1.0%, it signals strong consumer demand amid accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong demand
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in less than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 540000 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply contraction regimes (INDPRO < 95), manufacturing bottlenecks reduce corporate output and increase input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with INDPRO < 95, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.
